user_agent: cache-flow-collector/1.0 (personal job search; GitHub Actions; low request rate)

host_rules._note: Workday-specific client. One active request per Workday tenant (requests queue per host), 8-12s apart. Transport: Node's built-in https.request instead of fetch(), with the same honest user agent and headers (Workday's Cloudflare layer was reported in Nov 2026 to challenge fetch() but not https.request). A Cloudflare challenge (cf-mitigated) is never retried; a plain 429 honors Retry-After with bounded backoff. Failed scans keep previous roles.

One queue for all Eightfold hosts (add "group": "eightfold" to any other Eightfold tenant). Microsoft refused (429) after ~15 requests even at 7-12s spacing, so the reader works under a per-run request budget (sources.json: list_budget, search_budget, detail_budget) and stops at a refusal instead of retrying through it; one retry honors a short Retry-After.

_closure_note: Roles close only on evidence that covered them (see README, Collection rules). unverified_close_days: a role no scan has confirmed for this long is closed with basis unverified_expired. detail_max_age_days: stored details for relevant roles are re-read after this long, within each source's detail budget.
